question:
The sum of the radius of the base and slant height of a right circular cone is 49 cm. If the total surface area is 1848 cm²,

then its height is:

(Take π = frac{{22}}{7})
solution:
**Given:**

Slant height + radius = 49

Total surface area is 1848 cm2

**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/394ec2f3ebbf3b2685d18f445f4f9600d743b32cf650844afa61fb575c72c43f.png] 

l = √(r² + h²)

Total surface area of a right circular cone = πr(r + l)
